routes.S0: Saved imported baseline with frozen initializer settings.
routes.SC: H stays fishery removal; L=(1-f)H retained and D=fH designated, with no credited return.
routes.SM: Fishery catch L; M0 increases by D and EE decreases D/P. Returns follow existing biological fate; detritus accumulation closes fixed predation.
routes.SE: Fishery catch L plus separate external loss D. M0, EE and combined removal unchanged; mean weights see L.
routes.SR: Only the separately identified original Humboldt reference has a verified destination. Unavailable for every added model.

closure: Freeze completed living P,Q,diet,predation,accumulation,migration. Solve EE for SM; detritus accumulation absorbs routed inflow at fixed predation. No new consumption is assumed.
